key_insight: EvoDiff selects informative real ultrasound images for annotation, approaching fully supervised diagnostic performance with substantially fewer labels.
clinical_relevance: The framework could reduce expert annotation demands and improve ultrasound AI generalization to unseen clinical cohorts.
method: Uses diffusion-based feature optimization guided by information gain to generate synthetic probes.
Retrieves real unlabeled images for annotation; synthetic probes are not used as labeled training images.
Combines evolutionary search and curriculum-based sampling across heterogeneous ultrasound datasets.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered six benchmarks, 15 datasets and 16,696 images using convolutional and transformer-based models; a six-radiologist reader study supported a model-estimated 24%–84% annotation workload reduction at matched downstream performance.
watch_item: Workload reductions are model-based estimates, not demonstrated savings in routine clinical deployment.
paper_title: Generative Active Learning for Label-Efficient Pan-Organ Ultrasound Diagnosis
